answer: Honest participants recover value through epoch rewards, while attackers pay the burned quartz for every fake identity. Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-burn deposits: each agent identity must burn a small amount of quartz tokens, permanently destroyed, to register. The cost scales linearly, so a fable of thousands of free sybils collapses; each fake costs real jade. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
